title: How to Create and Render a Poster-Quality 3D Environment Effect
description: Want to create the same 3D environment effect as the cover! Quickly follow the official guide and keep watching!!!
transcript:
Welcome to my channel.  
Today I will show you how to make a very simple and easy cake.  
You will need 2 eggs.  
1 cup of sugar.  
1 cup of flour.  
1 cup of milk.  
1 teaspoon of cardamom powder.  
1 teaspoon of cinnamon.  
1 teaspoon of crackling.  
1 teaspoon of dill.  
1 teaspoon of salt.  
1 teaspoon of reap fantastic farina.  
One tablespoon of flour, adjust size of cake and press.  
Place a pan on low heat.  
Add all the sugar and daisy paste.  
Mannerum and pepper, traveled over cold water.  
We'll see you next time.  
Bye-bye.
